ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity pixels (white/cream) across the lateral lobes and 30% low-intensity pixels (black) concentrated in the central notch area and leading/trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region forming a wide inverted-V shape; large contiguous high-intensity white/cream regions on lateral lobes; distinct isolated black circular spot at the lower-inner quadrant of the left lobe (viewer perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 95 degrees; vertex partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-8 pixels along the outer distal edges, transitioning to larger, smoother undulations toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing edges leading to sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white/grey calcified clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips and superior leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, parallel dark linear marks (rake marks) on the central-right lobe; multiple unaligned thin vertical scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake mark scarring on the right-lobe ventral surface; dark circular focal lesion/mark on the lower-left lobe; irregular minor nicks along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown biofilm staining (diatome) distributed across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.
